name: Lemon Squeezy API
tagline: Merchant-of-record payments API for SaaS and digital products
description: REST API for Lemon Squeezy's merchant-of-record platform: products, checkouts, subscriptions, orders, customers, licenses, discounts, and webhooks. JSON:API format with Bearer token authentication.

auth.details: Bearer token API key in Authorization header; create keys in dashboard Settings → API.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Platform free until first sale (no monthly platform fee). API usage not separately metered. Transaction fees apply on sales (typically 5% + $0.50).
pricing.paid_plans: Standard platform fee 5% + $0.50 per transaction (covers payment processing and MoR costs); surcharges may apply (e.g. +1.5% international, +1.5% PayPal, +0.5% subscriptions, affiliate/marketing fees); custom pricing available.

rate_limits: 300 API calls per minute. Successful responses include X-Ratelimit-Limit and X-Ratelimit-Remaining; exceeding the limit returns 429 Too Many Requests.

example.request: curl -X GET "https://api.lemonsqueezy.com/v1/users/me" -H "Accept: application/vnd.api+json" -H "Content-Type: application/vnd.api+json" -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY"

use_cases: list products and variants for a store
create a checkout URL for a product
retrieve subscription status for a customer
manage license keys for digital products
register webhooks for order and subscription events
